about.title: Who you'll work with
about.lead: I'm Rifaldi, a web developer who <mark>builds websites professionally as a full-time job</mark>, and takes on freelance landing pages for founders and small businesses.
about.body: My approach is simple: take your brief, turn it into a fast, clean page, and get it live in days, not weeks. You get one person from first message to launch, so nothing gets lost between a designer, a developer, and a project manager.

cta.title: Have a page to <hl>launch</hl>?
cta.sub: Send a short brief: what the page is for and when you need it. I'll reply with the next steps.

consent.body: I use Google Analytics to see which pages are useful. It only runs if you allow it.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This site keeps things simple: no accounts, no contact forms, and no analytics unless you allow them.
privacy.collectBody: If you click Accept on the cookie banner, Google Analytics 4 records anonymous usage data: which pages are viewed, the rough region and device type, and clicks on the email buttons and project links. It does not tell me who you are. If you click Reject or ignore the banner, Google Analytics does not run and sets no cookies.

cookies.name: lang_pref
cookies.purpose: Remembers your language choice (English or Indonesian).

cookies.name: consent
cookies.purpose: Remembers whether you accepted or rejected analytics.

cookies.name: _ga, _ga_*
cookies.purpose: Google Analytics, set only after you click Accept.

privacy.changeBody: Use “Cookie settings” at the bottom of any page to change your choice at any time. Switching to Reject also removes the Google Analytics cookies.
privacy.emailBody: Your message is used only to reply and talk about your project. It is not added to a mailing list or shared with anyone.
privacy.contactBody: Email {email} about anything on this page.
